project_name: Bayesian Optimization and Design of Experiments for Pharmaceutical Formulation (BODoE)
summary: This industry-led project set out to couple BO and design of experiments with an automated laboratory setup for the formulation of pharmaceutical drug compounds as multi-component mixtures. Its stated aim was as much infrastructural as algorithmic: to define the data schemas and interfaces linking laboratory devices, property-prediction services such as COSMO-SAC\cite{mqs_cosmo_2024}, and the BO-driven experimental design loop, so that formulation campaigns could be planned and executed in a closed loop. No project code was published. The repository named on the project page turned out to be a fork of the hackathon website itself rather than a project repository, and has since been renamed by its owner; the team's public write-up of the COSMO-SAC component is the only accessible technical artifact. The scope reported here is therefore the intended one, and no results are available. (No recorded video was submitted for this project; this summary was prepared from the team's project page and the linked write-up.)
